projection_not_measurement.assumption: Future ZERO accepted steps remain3.125e-6 in ln(a) with no further rejections; no claim that this will occur.

projection_not_measurement.algorithm_adaptation_now: NOT_REQUIRED_BY_OBSERVED_FAILURE. Continue identical numerical method. Error target, fractions/thermal/photon metric, tolerances, source, grid, closures and acceptance guards stay frozen.

zero_continuation.required_start_state: Exactly the frozen actual ZERO terminal checkpoint, never a reconstructed/interpolated state or zbar20 restart.
zero_continuation.resource_fields_allowed: Only max_steps=500000,max_attempts=1550054,max_wall_s=15745.126871471 in an in-memory config copied from the exact original text. max_rhs=20000000 and output_budget_mib=2048 remain unchanged. The original on-disk config is never rewritten. All counters and wall_elapsed_s start at saved values; no resetting even when a resource limit is increased.
zero_continuation.mechanism: Add a new Rust example using the existing public DriverConfig,Driver::new,Driver::read_checkpoint,Driver::adaptive_step,Driver::output_batch,Driver::save_checkpoint_budget and compiled_identity APIs. Link the unchanged library. The new example owns only execution/output/resource glue and does not duplicate or modify tentative(),adaptive_step(),error_metric(),chemistry,geometry or source kernels.
zero_continuation.compatibility: Before reading the checkpoint require exact original config bytes/hash, exact saved case identity ZERO, and equality of existing public compiled_identity() with the original source_identity.txt. Verify frozen checkpoint bytes. The library source remains unchanged, so its identity relation remains exact. Record the new example/launcher/binary hashes separately as execution-wrapper identity; never represent the new wrapper as the original binary.
zero_continuation.binary_safety: Build only the new named example. Do not rebuild/replace the original target/release/examples/axbi_reionization executable used by live and pending original cases. No Cargo.toml/source-identity-listed file edits are allowed; Cargo autodiscovery of a new example supplies the entrypoint.
zero_continuation.outputs: Use a fresh segment directory runs/flrw/32d11e733155/ZERO_continuation_001 and sibling ZERO_continuation_001_raw. Retain original ZERO directory,RETURN,checkpoint,config,source_identity and raw evidence unchanged. Write segment-start boundary snapshot explicitly, followed by every new accepted row and normal spectral/checkpoint cadence; all rows retain original global scale factor/proper time and cumulative counters.
zero_continuation.segment_composition: A composed ZERO history is original prefix plus continuation rows after the exact shared boundary; count that boundary once. Do not rebase proper time, species,photons,energy/photon ledgers or diagnostics. Cumulative feedback/tau integrals must include the original prefix or carry the equivalent checked integral; a segment-only diagnostic cannot be labelled full-history. Both original and continuation identities accompany the composed dataset.
zero_continuation.stop: Stop at zbar4 or the first segment/cumulative resource limit or scientific guard failure. Preserve first failure and final/durable checkpoint. No second continuation is released. Resource exhaustion remains partial; a physical/numerical failure returns to authority. No tolerance relaxation or method repair occurs automatically.

signed_case_dispatch.explicit_policy_change: The prior stop-on-any-failure dispatch rule is superseded ONLY for verified accepted-step resource stops of these original phase1 cases. ZERO actual terminal evidence qualifies. This classification is retained as a failure/resource stop, never rewritten SUCCESS.
signed_case_dispatch.release: The three already-authorized unstarted signed cases may start while PLUS is active when one slot is free; each retains its original frozen binary/config/output and per-case caps. ZERO continuation completion is not a physical initial-condition dependency of these independently specified histories.
signed_case_dispatch.typed_nonblocking_stop: Require exited process group, exact case/config/source/checkpoint/RETURN binding, terminal AXBI_RUNTIME_CAP, accepted exactly200000 and no preceding accepted-state scientific guard failure. External exit101 alone is insufficient. Apply this rule to later original cases only if their actual terminal evidence satisfies it. Other errors or unknown exits still stop new dispatch for classification.
signed_case_dispatch.counting: Maximum5 distinct original initial-case starts, including existing ZERO and PLUS. ZERO_CONTINUATION_001 is a separately authorized additional process start: maximum6 full-stage process starts total, not a replacement baseline and not a reset of the original5 counter. Prior3 pilot launches remain charged; all-history process-start ceiling9 for this release.
signed_case_dispatch.concurrency: Maximum2 active scientific processes across PLUS, any signed case and ZERO continuation together. Count every adopted group, pending launch and new active process in one shared scheduler. Never operate independent launchers each assuming two free slots.
signed_case_dispatch.priority: After dispatch-only focused PASS, launch SHEAR_MINUS immediately in the currently free slot if ZERO continuation is not yet reviewed/ready. Once ZERO continuation passes review, reserve the next genuinely free slot for it before the half-amplitude cases. If ZERO continuation is already reviewed/ready at the first free slot, it has priority. Never preempt live cases.
signed_case_dispatch.remaining_cases_resource_limits: Unchanged10800wall/200000accepted/650000tentative/20000000RHS/2GiBoutput/one thread each. This decision does not extend PLUS or any other signed case, even if it later stops at the same cap.

cumulative_allocation.interpretation: Historical original limits and actual costs remain intact. Additional segment is explicitly charged under the same goal/node/case. The sum-wall ceiling reserves the whole additional segment conservatively; no unused old allocation is reset or hidden. More precise actual CPU and elapsed accounting remains separate.

allowed_paths.forbidden: Do not edit any existing frozen scientific source,original example,Cargo.toml,original config,binary,full/recovery binding or old raw receipt. No resets,stashes,new checkout,physical method change or mutation of live PLUS output.

implementation_and_review.worker_role: Lower-tier coding/execution worker. Authority remains read-only. Preserve existing dirty state and request/runtime model identity separately.
implementation_and_review.command_limit_note: These are the permitted build/test/self-check targets; worker binds exact CLI,CPU/external limits and binary/output paths before launch. Do not invent execution flags in this authority record.
implementation_and_review.mechanical_regression: One fake scheduler check proves typed accepted-cap stop permits only independent signed starts, numerical/unknown failure blocks, adopted PLUS plus one new job saturates concurrency, continuation occupies the same slots, original5 and total6 launch caps hold, repeated polls never duplicate. One bounded component test checks checkpoint continuation against an uninterrupted invocation of the same public numerical kernel on a manufactured fixture, including gas/photons/ledgers/counters and original state preservation; also reject wrong predecessor/config/case and already-existing segment. No physical full history is run as a test.
implementation_and_review.independent_gate: Fresh reviewer,not implementer,checks exact new wrapper diff, unchanged original source/binary and compiled_identity equality, resource-only config differences, original/cumulative accounting, segment composition, scheduler shared occupancy and raw test outputs. Review scopes can be decided independently so dispatch PASS need not await ZERO wrapper completion.
implementation_and_review.one_repair_rule: If review identifies one concrete defect, return one bounded targeted repair to the lower-tier worker and recheck only that changed surface. Otherwise exact missing input/HOLD; do not expand generic readiness audits.
positive_transitions: DISPATCH_PASS -> start the shared post-cap observer and next eligible original signed case immediately within caps.
ZERO_CONTINUATION_PASS -> add the one continuation to that same scheduler and execute at next free slot, with cumulative caps and no restart of oldZERO.
ACTUAL_COMPLETED_ZERO -> compose preserved prefix and new segment,generate actual full-interval plots and send actual-data independent review; continue ready original signed cases.
SECOND_RESOURCE_STOP -> preserve exact partial continuation evidence and return finite outcome; no automatic further allocation.
implementation_and_review.scientific_admission_gate: Execution-wrapper PASS is not full-history or convergence admission. Actual completed composed history and relevant refinements still determine AX11/C11/AX15 and signed accuracy.

public_api_viability.private_helpers: open_output,check_resources,reconcile_outputs,summarize_feedback,checkpoint_text and checkpoint serializer internals are private. No exposure/refactor of those functions is required or authorized.
public_api_viability.viable_execution_path: New example creates absent segment directory and ordinary new BufWriter files with exact existing CSV headers, calls public output_batch with the frozen checkpoint for its boundary snapshot, and then executes public adaptive_step. Copy only existing run-loop orchestration semantics: cumulative wall/caps, raw reject recording,30consecutive-reject/minimum-step rules, output-batch rollback retaining charged attempts/RHS/rejects/comparisons, flush and normal spectrum/checkpoint cadence. The numerical kernel and error estimator remain called from unchanged library.
public_api_viability.no_reconciliation_needed: This release allows exactly one new segment process and no retry into existing output. It never appends to original files or an existing segment. Therefore private reconcile_outputs is unnecessary. A crash leaves raw tails and last durable checkpoint for classification; no resumed segment is automatically released.
public_api_viability.checkpoint_serialization: Call public save_checkpoint_budget for atomic checkpoint serialization and public ensure_spectrum_snapshot for terminal snapshot. Do not duplicate private checkpoint format logic or rebuild initial_energy by hand.
public_api_viability.guards_and_endpoint: Load with public read_checkpoint, which validates cumulative ledgers at1e-8. Retain inherited per-step validation1e-10 through adaptive_step and the unchanged positivity/charge/reflection guards. At terminal, require state.a==1/(1+4.0) before any COMPLETE_SEGMENT_TO_SELECTED_ENDPOINT status, and public validate(state,1e-8). Record public residuals,original initial-energy reference,all cumulative counters, and actual rejection/error outcomes. Endpoint absence is partial even if a wrapper exits0.
public_api_viability.feedback_output: Public output_batch emits instantaneous feedback and ledger rows. Private summarize_feedback is unnecessary for advancing the segment; full-history feedback must be computed downstream over the exact original+segment sequence with the original summation formula,shared boundary once. Until then its whole-history diagnostic is PENDING,never a zero or segment-only substitute.
public_api_viability.component_test_scope: Expose testable execution glue within the new example using a path module/import in the new test,or equivalent local helper structure confined to the two allowed new Rust files. Test resource cap/error/rollback and segment writer behavior as well as manufactured-state checkpoint roundtrip; do not make unchanged solver reimplementation the test oracle.

segment_identity.output_budget: Original case retains its historical2048MiB cap. New segment independently gets2048MiB=1920MiBscience+128MiBlauncher. Their sum is at most4096MiB. New post-cap allocation metadata is charged to the new segment launcher reserve and actual original raw bytes stay in their original envelope.
